title: A Programmable DNA-Silicification-Based Nanocavity for Single-Molecule Plasmonic Sensing

lanes.label: Classical tools

states.title: Hypothesis and design
states.head: DNA-assembled plasmonic nanoassemblies lack the stability and gap control needed for quantitative single-molecule SERS. Conformally silicifying the DNA should stabilise the nanoassembly and fix its nanogaps (DNA-STROBE).
states.detail: Absorbed: n1 (HYP/need), n2 (HYP/hypothesis), n3 (DES/base_system), n4 (DES/route), n5 (PRC/synthesis), n6 (PRC/deposition)

states.title: Structure state
states.head: An ultrathin silica shell conformally covers the gold nanoassembly. Silicification narrows the spread of dimer centre-to-centre distances, i.e.

states.title: Property state and mechanisms
states.head: Flexible DNA duplexes fold and bend, scattering gap size; silica encapsulation locks the duplex and condenses the gap. Silicified core-satellite assemblies stay dispersed with unchanged absorption after 2 h at pH 4 and pH 7.4.
states.detail: Absorbed: n11 (MEC/pathway), n12 (PRP/value), n16 (MEC/pathway), n19 (MEC/pathway), n24 (MEC/pathway). Premises: A 19-bp duplex is ~6 nm long, so a stretched aligned duplex would give ~46 nm dimer centre distance; SERS enhancement factor scales as |E|^4/|E0|^4 of the local near field; Single R6G molecules show intrinsic SERS blinking

states.title: Performance state
states.head: Silicified constructs give reproducible SERS of 0.1 uM R6G with smaller intensity variation than unsilicified ones. Single-molecule SERS events are detected from temporal intensity fluctuations at 0.1 uM R6G.
states.detail: Absorbed: n17 (PRF/service_capability), n18 (PRF/service_capability), n20 (PRF/service_capability). Premises: Temporal intensity-fluctuation analysis is used to identify single-molecule events; Fitting each single-molecule emission's point-spread function and superimposing centroids localises emitters beyond the diffraction limit

states.title: Conclusion
states.head: DNA silicification yields stable, gap-controlled plasmonic nanocavities enabling reproducible, single-molecule and super-resolution SERS
